label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA090Subtitle
text: * I sense the time of your demise growing near, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA091Subtitle
text: *Your forces are beginning to be overrun, General. Soon they will be my prisoners

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA092Subtitle
text: *We are kicking you like a wounded goat, General. Admit defeat to spare your agony

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA093Subtitle
text: *You are defeated. This is what happens to all who stand against me , General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA094Subtitle
text: *You are a fool to challenge me, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA095Subtitle
text: *All the powers of the GLA are at my disposal

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA096Subtitle
text: *I am more dangerous than all my three Generals combined

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA097Subtitle
text: *You have won, General. Why do you continue to torture me by examining these statistics?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA098Subtitle
text: *Yes, you can now see why you have lostthe numbers speak for themselves

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA099Subtitle
text: *You have traveled far and faced many opponents to reach me General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA100Subtitle
text: *I commend your efforts, but they have wholly unprepared you for what you are about to face

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA101Subtitle
text: *You have faced Dr. Thrax's toxic warriors; Kassad's stealth legions and Juhziz's demolitions, but I taught them all in the art of war

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA102Subtitle
text: *This will be your final battle, General. May whatever gods you pray to have mercy on youbecause I will not

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossGLA103Subtitle
text: *This will be your final battle, General. Make your peace and prepare for the end

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA001Subtitle
text: *Well, there you are. Too late to run now, Boy

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA002Subtitle
text: *I hope you're ready, cause we're coming for ya

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA003Subtitle
text: *Set the table, Kid, cause we're coming for dinner

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA004Subtitle
text: *I've got three things to teach you, Kid: How to lose; how to cry; and how to die

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA005Subtitle
text: *We're coming to attack soon, so get out all your white flags

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA006Subtitle
text: *Here we come, Kidtry not to wet yourself, okay?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA007Subtitle
text: *What part of "die" didn't you understand?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA008Subtitle
text: *Ooh, you're going to get it now, Kid

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA009Subtitle
text: *You ready? Cause here comes a tactic you may have learned in school. You ready to go back to school?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA010Subtitle
text: *It's time for me to teach you a thing or two about the back of my hand

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA011Subtitle
text: *You should have run when you had the chance. Now I'm going to teach you the meaning of respect

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA012Subtitle
text: *So, about your funeralopen casket or closed?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA013Subtitle
text: *I'm gonna march into your base and plant my foot in your butt, <sarcastic> "General."

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA014Subtitle
text: *Here we come, Punk--step aside or get stepped on

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA015Subtitle
text: *You call yourself a "General"? I call you a pain in the butt, is what I call you

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA016Subtitle
text: *This is your idea of strategy? Of tactics? "Tank blob" is the best you can come up with? Patheticjust pathetic

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA017Subtitle
text: *Yeah, I've read Sun Tzu too, Sport: "Greater enemy--retreat. Smaller enemy--attack." Is that all you got for me?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA018Subtitle
text: *So, where's your army, Boy? Or did you just want to bare-knuckle it? Cause I'll slap you down with my bare hands if you want. You want a piece of that, Boy?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA019Subtitle
text: *You got me out of bed for this? I aught to take you over my knee right now

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA020Subtitle
text: *I got more medals than you've got teeth, Boywhich won't be saying much after I get done knocking them out for you

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA021Subtitle
text: *Are you putting all of your defenses at the front of your base? You don't think we can go around that? Well, do you?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA022Subtitle
text: *Boy, you think I'm playing with you? You better think again

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA023Subtitle
text: *Better check your flanks there, Partner; I think some of my troops just snuck into your base

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA024Subtitle
text: *Do you think this is a game? Well do you? Wait, don't answer that

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA025Subtitle
text: *Kid, who taught you military tactics? Huh? Cause you should go slap him square in the mouth, I tell you

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA026Subtitle
text: *I have the whole United States military behind me, Son, and I've just decided that we don't like you

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA027Subtitle
text: *Is this tactic of yours supposed to be some kind of joke I'm not aware of?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA028Subtitle
text: *So, you're not a real general, are you? You're like the Surgeon General or something like that, right?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA029Subtitle
text: *Does your mommy know you're out by yourself?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA030Subtitle
text: *You can tell me.. We're just Generals here Do your men know you're incompetent?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA031Subtitle
text: *Did you know you just lost a Tech Building, Sport?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA032Subtitle
text: *Just blew-up your Barracks, Skippy. What you gonna do about it?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA033Subtitle
text: *There goes your War Factory. You mad yet, Boy?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA034Subtitle
text: *I don't know why you bothered to build that Air Field if you aren't going to protect it

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA035Subtitle
text: *Who put these base defenses down like this? They can't defend anything like that

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA036Subtitle
text: *I should let you build another Command Center just so I could knock it down again

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA037Subtitle
text: *I feel like I'm kicking over sand castles. How many of your buildings you gonna let me destroy there, Sport?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA038Subtitle
text: *I let you have that Tech Building, Boy. I don't need it to beat you

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA039Subtitle
text: *Kid, that Barracks was not a military target. Do that again and this will get ugly

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA040Subtitle
text: *You better stand down, Son--I'm not going to stand for you blowing-up my War Factories, you hear?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA041Subtitle
text: *Do you know how much those jets cost? I coulda fed the whole world with what you just destroyed

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA042Subtitle
text: *Cracking my defenses, huh? Well, go on--it should be me just enough time to overrun your base

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA043Subtitle
text: *That's enough buildings, Son. Why don't you try attacking my forces now

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA044Subtitle
text: *My Command Center?! You think I'm just going to sit here and take that?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA045Subtitle
text: *You had best leave my pilots alone, Boy. Planes are one thing, but you let my pilots return safe, you hear?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA046Subtitle
text: *You're a sneaky little 'cuss, aren't you? But I think that's enough of my vehicles destroyed, don't you?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA047Subtitle
text: *Let's get armor and air support out there--our grunts are getting torn apart!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA048Subtitle
text: *Let that Oil Derrick go, Boy. This war ain't about the price of gas you know

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA049Subtitle
text: *Think you know how to use that Artillery Platform, Son?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA050Subtitle
text: *That Oil Refinery is not a viable target, Son. And it don't belong to you, so we're coming to get it back

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA051Subtitle
text: *Well, you managed to get to my side of the map. Didn't think you had it in ya

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA052Subtitle
text: *You planning to attack, or you just going to stand out there all day?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA053Subtitle
text: *You'll get out of my base if you know what's good for you, Boy

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA054Subtitle
text: *Enemy's in our perimeter--all forces repel the invaders

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA055Subtitle
text: *Those ain't your supplies, Sport. Best to step-off now, before you get hurt

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA056Subtitle
text: *A flanking attack?! Don't make me laugh, Boy

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA057Subtitle
text: *Trying to attack from my back-door? Good luck with that

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA058Subtitle
text: *You coming to attack me, Boy? Nice to see you have some guts

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA059Subtitle
text: *Get away from my Tech buildings, if you know what's good for you

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA060Subtitle
text: *My forces have your base in sight, Kid. What you gonna do now?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA061Subtitle
text: *Here comes the hammer, Punk, and you don't want to be the nail

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA062Subtitle
text: *Knock-knock, we're coming in!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA063Subtitle
text: *Things are about to get real bad for you, Sport. Don't say I didn't warn you

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA064Subtitle
text: *So, here's where you're hiding your resources. Mind if I take a few?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA065Subtitle
text: *You're flank's wide open, Sport

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA066Subtitle
text: *Maybe we'll come in your back-door. Whadda you think about that?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA067Subtitle
text: *Look out, we're coming through the front-door!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA068Subtitle
text: *What do we have here?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA069Subtitle
text: *Well, look at this

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA070Subtitle
text: *What did you plan to do without power? I can't wait to see this strategy

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA071Subtitle
text: *You better pay you power bill or we're going to have to postpone this fight

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA072Subtitle
text: *You're out of resources? Boy, you don't start the dance if you can't pay the bill

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA073Subtitle
text: *Uh-oh, looks like we're going to have to do some deficit spending

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA074Subtitle
text: *Built yourself a Scud Storm there? You can't hit the side of a barn with a scud, don't you know that?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA075Subtitle
text: *Bringing out your nukes, huh? If Washington hadn't tied my hands, I'd show you some nukes, I tell you

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA076Subtitle
text: *How'd you get a Particle Cannon, Son? That's supposed to me top-secret

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA077Subtitle
text: *So many base defenses. I can just smell the fear coming off you, Boy

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA078Subtitle
text: *Oh, look at thishere comes the tank blob. Not gonna work against me, Son

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA079Subtitle
text: *That's a lot of expensive planes you're putting in the air, Kid. Sure you wanna spend that money?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA080Subtitle
text: *Hope all those grunts know what you're getting them into

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA081Subtitle
text: *That's a lot of buildings, Son. You know that buildings can't fight for you, right?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA082Subtitle
text: *Bring the scuds, Punk--I'll show you the storm

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA083Subtitle
text: *You're going to regret nuking me, Kid. I don't take kindly to that

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA084Subtitle
text: *Using a particle beam, eh? You better put me away with that cause you won't like my counter-attack

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA085Subtitle
text: *You know, only a coward fights from inside buildings. You know that, right?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA086Subtitle
text: *Welcome, Colonel Burton. Sorry you had to get tied up in this thing. No hard feelings

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA087Subtitle
text: *Black Lotus ain't your salvation, Boy. She ain't gonna get anywhere near my base

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA088Subtitle
text: *Jarmen Kell's just another sniper, Punk. I've got dozens of snipers

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA089Subtitle
text: *Yeah, build your Air Field--get some birds in the air. May be your only shot a stopping me

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA090Subtitle
text: *Only one War Factory? It's gonna take at least half-a-dozen to stop me, Kid

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA091Subtitle
text: *Is that Barracks a little close to the front-lines, Kid? Hard to sleep with bullets in your barracks

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA092Subtitle
text: *Don't just sell one building, Boy--sell them all and hope that I don't come for you anyway

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA093Subtitle
text: *Don't get cocky, Boy--this ain't over yet

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA094Subtitle
text: *You may think you have the upper-hand, but I've got a few tricks left in me. You'll see

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA095Subtitle
text: *I've dug myself outta worse holes than this, Punk. You ain't gonna win that easily

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA096Subtitle
text: *You think you're beating me? You best think again

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA097Subtitle
text: *HuhI guess it's over. Nice work, Kid. I guess you took me down a peg or two

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA098Subtitle
text: *Can you feel my fist starting to close around your neck, Punk?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA099Subtitle
text: *Don't take losing to me so hard--everyone loses to me, Kid

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA100Subtitle
text: *Give me a sec to get some tanks together and I'll end this little skirmish

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA101Subtitle
text: *Why don't you just give up now, <sarcastic> "General."

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA102Subtitle
text: *Boy, I beat you like an old drum. Who gave you a command? Cause I've got some word for them

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA103Subtitle
text: *Don't click that button unless you're serious, Boy

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA104Subtitle
text: *You wanna tangle with me? I think you better think again, Kid

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA105Subtitle
text: *Don't bring that attitude in here unless you can back it up, Punk

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA106Subtitle
text: *Show me what you got

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA107Subtitle
text: *Maybe you could make a few extra bucks polishing my boots, cause you sure ain't no general

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA108Subtitle
text: *Good work, General. I salute you

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_BossUSA109Subtitle
text: *I ain't gonna give no speeches, so let's just get this on

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo001Subtitle
text: *I have some surprises for you, General. Why don't you come out and play?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo002Subtitle
text: *Now that the field is covered with explosives, I suppose we'll attack

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo003Subtitle
text: *General, I have a delivery for yousign for it, won't you?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo004Subtitle
text: *Careful, who knows when Jarmen Kell will sneak into your base

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo005Subtitle
text: *Did your building just blow up? HmmI wonder how that happened?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo006Subtitle
text: *All of my forces are packed with explosives, General. I wouldn't shoot at them if I were you

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo007Subtitle
text: *My Terrorists have learned to disguise themselves asoops, have I said too much?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo008Subtitle
text: *You might notice that my explosives pack a bit more punchI hope you appreciate our attention to quality

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo009Subtitle
text: *Look how quickly the Scud Launcher destroys a building nowjust wait, it's amazing

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo010Subtitle
text: *First, all is silencethen "boom!"ahhdon't you just love it, General?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo011Subtitle
text: *I rarely attack, you should feel honored

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo012Subtitle
text: *Here comes another attack, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo013Subtitle
text: *My troops are coming to assault your basemake them feel welcome

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo014Subtitle
text: *Please ignore my workers, General; they're just burying someummgarbage for me

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo015Subtitle
text: *Oh, General, you must see thisit's the bomb. <childish laugh>

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo016Subtitle
text: *We're going out for more explosives, General. Be right back

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo017Subtitle
text: *It's quiet out there, General. You know what quiet means, right? BOOM!!!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo018Subtitle
text: *I am the master of explosives, General. You have no defense against me

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo019Subtitle
text: *Your base has been targeted for demolition

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo020Subtitle
text: *Do you fear my next attack, General? You should

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo021Subtitle
text: *As we speak my agents are sneaking into your base and planting explosives

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo022Subtitle
text: *Your building could be wired to explode right now. You'll never know until it's too late

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo023Subtitle
text: *There are few units that can detect my demolitionsdo you know which ones they are?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo024Subtitle
text: *Demo Traps are difficult to construct, General. To appreciate their beauty you have to see one up close

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo025Subtitle
text: *How are you enjoying my tricks and traps so far?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo026Subtitle
text: *Awwyour Tech Building went boom

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo027Subtitle
text: *We've destroyed your BarracksI hope no one was in there

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo028Subtitle
text: *Your War Factory has fallen, General. Build another one so we can knock it down again

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo029Subtitle
text: *Air Fields are so fragile--it's hardly even fun to destroy them

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo030Subtitle
text: *Your base defenses cannot take my explosives, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo031Subtitle
text: *Ah, there's nothing quite like destroying a Command Center

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo032Subtitle
text: *We've destroyed so many of your buildings, GeneralI appreciate you building more for our ammusement

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo033Subtitle
text: *You've destroyed our Oil Derrick. Now you're getting into the spirit of things

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo034Subtitle
text: *My Barracks! Many of my demolitions were in there, General. I'll make you pay for this

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo035Subtitle
text: *Not my War Factory! General, this annoy habit you've developed cannot continue

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo036Subtitle
text: *Not to worry, my base defenses are only an early-warning signal. Now you must walk through my true defenses

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo037Subtitle
text: *Too many! You've destroy too many of my structures, General. Now the fighting gets dirty

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo038Subtitle
text: *We will rebuild that Command Center, General, and you will play for this transgression

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo039Subtitle
text: *General, how do you expect me to defeat you if you keep destroying my vehicles?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo040Subtitle
text: *You're cutting my men down before they can place their demolitionsthat doesn't seem right, does it, General?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo041Subtitle
text: *Ah yes, capture that Oil Derrick, General. Then we'll have more to destroy

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo042Subtitle
text: *General, why do you want that Artillery Platform?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo043Subtitle
text: *Good, General, capture the Oil Refinerythey blow-up so dramatically

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo044Subtitle
text: *Be careful, General--your men have just enter the danger zone around my base. Even I don't remember where all the traps are set out there

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo045Subtitle
text: *General, your men are coming dangerously close to my base. I'd turn back if I were you

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo046Subtitle
text: *Get out of my base, General. This whole area is wired with explosives, and I'm not afraid to use them

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo047Subtitle
text: *You fool! Do you know how many explosives are surrounding your men right now?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo048Subtitle
text: *Attacking from the flank, General? There might be few defenses there, but what about traps?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo049Subtitle
text: *The back of my base is particularly nasty, General. I wouldn't recommend an assault from there

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo050Subtitle
text: *A frontal assault?! You are more of a fool than I thought, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo051Subtitle
text: *There is nothing in this valley for you except death

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo052Subtitle
text: *Careful, General; this looks like a good place for an ambushoops, too late

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo053Subtitle
text: *You think I didn't prepare for you coming here, General? Fool

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo054Subtitle
text: *Those are my resources, General. Go find your own

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo055Subtitle
text: *General, you've entered my demolitions storage facility. One false move and we all die

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo056Subtitle
text: *Ah, I see we hit one of your power lines. I hope your power isn't out for too long

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo057Subtitle
text: *Your dependency on electricity will be you undoing, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo058Subtitle
text: *Your resources are exhausted, General. My forces are circling for the kill

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo059Subtitle
text: *My resources are low, General. Mind if we come take some of yours?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo060Subtitle
text: *A Scud StormI seeWell, perhaps it is time to build one of my own

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo061Subtitle
text: *I wonder how many explosives it will take to destroy that Nuclear Silo?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo062Subtitle
text: *Now why do you want to build a Particle Cannon? We were just beginning to have fun, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo063Subtitle
text: *So many base defenses, General. How do you expect my bombers to enter your base now?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo064Subtitle
text: *Tanksso many tanks. I'll enjoy watching your tanks hit my traps, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo065Subtitle
text: *Stop building planes, Generalyou'll miss the genius of my traps

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo066Subtitle
text: *With that many infantry you're sure to set-off my Demo Traps. I'd tell them to spread out when crossing the field, Generalor not

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo067Subtitle
text: *So many buildings Your base is a perfect target for my explosives, General. Thank you

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo068Subtitle
text: *Foolish move, General. Your Scud Storm won't stop me

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo069Subtitle
text: *Nuclear missile! You will pay for this, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo070Subtitle
text: *No! That particle beam will set off my explosives!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo071Subtitle
text: *Yes, garrison that building, General--it probably doesn't have explosives attached to it

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo072Subtitle
text: *Hello, Colonel Burton. Try not to step on any traps

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo073Subtitle
text: *Black Lotusjust because you can detect my traps do not think I am now vulnerable

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo074Subtitle
text: *Why would you send Jarmen Kell against me, General?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo075Subtitle
text: *Do not build any more Air Fields, GeneralI don't like them

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo076Subtitle
text: *The War Factory builds vehiclesvehicles that will set-off my Demo Traps

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo077Subtitle
text: *Do you think it is wise to build a Barracks, General?
